object.script:
position_count = property.getNumber("Position Count") min_traction = property.getNumber("Minimum Traction") max_traction = property.getNumber("Maximum Traction") control_axis = property.getNumber("Control Axis")
current_position = 0 prev_seat_state = 0 prev_plus_state = false prev_minus_state = false
function onTick() local from_seat = 0 local from_seatPlus = false local from_seatMinus = false
EBR = input.getBool(3)
if control_axis == 1 then from_seat = input.getNumber(1) elseif control_axis == 2 then from_seat = input.getNumber(2) elseif control_axis == 3 then from_seat = input.getNumber(3) elseif control_axis == 4 then from_seat = input.getNumber(4) elseif control_axis == 5 then from_seatPlus = input.getBool(1) from_seatMinus = input.getBool(2) end
if control_axis >= 1 and control_axis <= 4 then if from_seat > 0 and prev_seat_state <= 0 then current_position = current_position + 1 elseif from_seat < 0 and prev_seat_state >= 0 then current_position = current_position - 1 end prev_seat_state = from_seat end
if control_axis == 5 then if from_seatPlus and not prev_plus_state then current_position = current_position + 1 end if from_seatMinus and not prev_minus_state then current_position = current_position - 1 end prev_plus_state = from_seatPlus prev_minus_state = from_seatMinus end
current_position = math.max(0, math.min(current_position, position_count))
if EBR == true then traction = 0 prev_seat_state = 0 prev_plus_state = false prev_minus_state = false current_position = 0 else if current_position == 0 then traction = 0 elseif position_count <= 1 then traction = min_traction else local t = (current_position - 1) / (position_count - 1) traction = min_traction + t * (max_traction - min_traction) end end
output.setNumber(1, traction) output.setNumber(2, current_position) end

object.script:
-- Up/Down Counter local trainCounter = {value = 4, prev = 0} local indepCounter = {value = 2, prev = 0} local function stepCounter(state, dir, step, minVal, maxVal) if dir ~= state.prev then state.value = math.max( minVal, math.min(maxVal, state.value + dir * step) ) end state.prev = dir return state.value end
-- Consumption Rate Function local TPU = 30 local function Consumption() local buf, sum, prev = {}, 0, nil return function(v) if not prev then prev = v return 0 end local d = prev - v prev = v if #buf == TPU then sum = sum - buf[1] table.remove(buf, 1) end buf[#buf + 1] = d sum = sum + d return sum / #buf * 60 end end
local consBLCalc = Consumption() local consETCalc = Consumption()
-- Pressure Stabilizator Function local function pressureStab(isActive, currentValve, targetPressure, currentRate) if not isActive then return 0 end local err = targetPressure - currentRate if math.abs(err) < 0.001 then return currentValve end currentValve = currentValve + err * 0.02 return math.max(0, math.min(1, currentValve)) end
local v = {0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0} -- Valve 1..9 local z1, z2, consBL, consET, brakeForce, timer = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 local compressor = false local detectEmergencyBrake = false
function onTick() chargingPressMT = property.getNumber("Main Tank Charging Pressure") chargingPressET = property.getNumber("Equalizing Tank Charging Pressure") chargingOverpressET = property.getNumber("Equalizing Tank Charging Overpressure") chargingPressST = property.getNumber("Supply Tank Charging Pressure") chargingPressBC = property.getNumber("Brake Cylinder Charging Pressure") airDistrSens = property.getNumber("Air Distributor Sensitivity (atm/s)") brakeForceMult = property.getNumber("Brake Force Multiplier")
prMT = input.getNumber(1) prET = input.getNumber(2) prBL = input.getNumber(3) prST = input.getNumber(4) prBC = input.getNumber(5) seatAD = input.getNumber(6) seatWS = input.getNumber(7)
toggleCompressor = input.getBool(1) emergencyBrakeRequest = input.getBool(2)
consBL = consBLCalc(prBL) consET = consETCalc(prET)
if consBL > 0.45 then timer = math.max(0, math.min(60, timer + 1)) if timer >= 45 then detectEmergencyBrake = true end else timer = 0 detectEmergencyBrake = false end
trainBrakePos = stepCounter(trainCounter, -seatWS, 1, 1, 7) indepBrakePos = stepCounter(indepCounter, -seatAD, 1, 1, 6)
if not toggleCompressor then compressor = false elseif prMT >= chargingPressMT then compressor = false elseif prMT <= chargingPressMT * 0.95 then compressor = true end
-- Train Brake if not (emergencyBrakeRequest or detectEmergencyBrake) then -- I - Release and Charging if trainBrakePos == 1 then if z1 == 0 then if prBL < chargingOverpressET * 1.05 then v[1] = 0.8 else v[1] = 0 end
v[5] = 0
if (prBL >= chargingOverpressET * 1.05) and (prET >= chargingOverpressET) then z1 = 1 end elseif z1 == 1 then v[1] = 0 v[5] = pressureStab(true, v[5], 0.01, consBL) if prBL <= chargingOverpressET then z1 = 2 end else v[1] = 0 v[5] = 0 end
if z2 == 0 then v[2] = 0.25 v[4] = 0 if prET >= chargingOverpressET then z2 = 1 end elseif z2 == 1 then v[2] = 0 v[4] = pressureStab(true, v[4], 0.01, consET) if prET <= chargingOverpressET then z2 = 2 end else v[2] = 0 v[4] = 0 end
v[3] = 0
trainPivotPos = 0.2
-- II - Train Drive and Elimination of Overpressure elseif trainBrakePos == 2 then if prBL > chargingPressET + 0.15 then v[4] = pressureStab(true, v[4], 0.003, consBL) v[2] = 0 elseif (prBL > chargingPressET - 0.05) and (prBL < chargingPressET + 0.15) then v[4] = 0 v[2] = 0 elseif prBL < chargingPressET - 0.05 then v[4] = 0 v[2] = 0.3 end
v[1] = 0 v[3] = math.max(0, math.min(1, v[3] + 0.001)) v[5] = 0
trainPivotPos = 0.1
z1, z2 = 0, 0
-- III - Overlap without feeding elseif trainBrakePos == 3 then v[1] = 0 v[2] = 0 v[3] = 0 v[4] = 0 v[5] = 0
trainPivotPos = 0
z1, z2 = 0, 0
-- IV - Overlap with feeding elseif trainBrakePos == 4 then v[2] = 0 v[3] = 0 v[4] = 0
if prBL > prET then v[1] = 0 v[5] = pressureStab(true, v[5], 0.01, consBL) elseif prBL < prET then v[1] = 0.075 v[5] = 0 end
trainPivotPos = -0.15
-- Va - Low-speed Service Braking elseif trainBrakePos == 5 then v[1] = 0 v[2] = 0 v[3] = 0
if prBL < prET then v[4] = pressureStab(true, v[4], 0.04, consET) end
v[5] = pressureStab(true, v[5], 0.04, math.max(0, math.min(1, consBL)))
trainPivotPos = -0.35
-- V - Service Braking elseif trainBrakePos == 6 then v[1] = 0 v[2] = 0 v[3] = 0
if prBL < prET then v[4] = pressureStab(true, v[4], 0.15, consET) end
v[5] = pressureStab(true, v[5], 0.15, math.max(0, math.min(1, consBL)))
trainPivotPos = -0.45
-- VI - Emergency Brake elseif trainBrakePos == 7 then v[1] = 0 v[2] = 0 v[3] = 0
if prBL < prET then v[4] = 0.6 end
v[5] = 0.6
trainPivotPos = -0.7 end else v[1] = 0 v[2] = 0 v[3] = 0 v[4] = 0.6 v[5] = 0.6
trainBrakePos = 7 trainCounter.value = 7 trainPivotPos = -0.7 end
-- Air Destributor if prBL > prST and prST < chargingPressST then v[6] = 1 v[7] = 0 v[8] = 0.5 elseif prST >= chargingPressST and consBL < airDistrSens then v[6] = 0 v[7] = 0 v[8] = 0 elseif consBL > airDistrSens then v[6] = 0 v[7] = math.max(0, ((prST * 1.07) - prBL) / 7) v[8] = 0 else v[6] = 0 v[7] = 0 v[8] = 0 end
-- Independent Brake if indepBrakePos == 1 and seatAD ~= 1 then indepBrakePos = 2 indepCounter.value = 2 end
-- I - Release if indepBrakePos == 1 then v[9] = 0 v[8] = 0.5
indepPivotPos = 0.2
-- II - Train Drive elseif indepBrakePos == 2 then v[9] = 0
indepPivotPos = 0
-- III - First Brake Position elseif indepBrakePos == 3 then if prBC < 1.15 then v[9] = 0.2 v[8] = 0 elseif prBC <= 1.15 * 1.1 then v[9] = 0 v[8] = 0 else v[9] = 0 v[8] = 0.25 end
indepPivotPos = -0.2
-- IV - Second Brake Position elseif indepBrakePos == 4 then if prBC < 1.85 then v[9] = 0.2 v[8] = 0 elseif prBC <= 1.85 * 1.1 then v[9] = 0 v[8] = 0 else v[9] = 0 v[8] = 0.25 end
indepPivotPos = -0.3
-- V - Third Brake Position elseif indepBrakePos == 5 then if prBC < 2.85 then v[9] = 0.2 v[8] = 0 elseif prBC <= 2.85 * 1.1 then v[9] = 0 v[8] = 0 else v[9] = 0 v[8] = 0.25 end
indepPivotPos = -0.4
-- VI - Fourth Brake Position elseif indepBrakePos == 6 then if prBC < 3.9 then v[9] = 0.2 v[8] = 0 elseif prBC <= 3.9 * 1.1 then v[9] = 0 v[8] = 0 else v[9] = 0 v[8] = 0.25 end
indepPivotPos = -0.5 end
brakeForce = (prBC / chargingPressBC) * brakeForceMult
output.setNumber(1, trainBrakePos) output.setNumber(2, indepBrakePos) output.setNumber(3, v[1]) output.setNumber(4, v[2]) output.setNumber(5, v[3]) output.setNumber(6, v[4]) output.setNumber(7, v[5]) output.setNumber(8, v[6]) output.setNumber(9, v[7]) output.setNumber(10, v[8]) output.setNumber(11, v[9]) output.setNumber(12, brakeForce) output.setNumber(13, trainPivotPos) output.setNumber(14, indepPivotPos) output.setNumber(15, trainBrakePos) output.setNumber(16, indepBrakePos) output.setNumber(31, consET) output.setNumber(32, consBL)
output.setBool(32, compressor) end
function onDraw() screen.setColor(0, 255, 0) screen.drawText(0, 0, consBL) end
